article.description: Washington Wizards (1-1, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Charlotte Hornets (2-1, fifth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Charlotte and Washington square off in conference showdown
article.linkText: Charlotte and Washington square off in conference showdown
article.story: Washington Wizards (1-1, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Charlotte Hornets (2-1, fifth in the Eastern Conference) Charlotte, North Carolina; Monday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Eastern Conference foes Charlotte and Washington face off on Monday. Charlotte finished 44-38 overall, 11-5 in Southeast Division action and 21-20 at home last season. The Hornets averaged 116.0 points per game last season, 45.2 in the paint, 15.6 off of turnovers and 13.3 on fast breaks. Washington finished 17-65 overall and 11-41 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards allowed opponents to score 124.9 points per game and shoot 48.8% from the field last season. INJURIES: Hornets: Grant Williams: out (hamstring), Kylan Boswell: out (knee), Kon Knueppel: out (hamstring), Coby White: out (calf). Wizards: AJ Dybantsa: out (ankle), Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
